name: The Witcher 3 Remastered
compatibilityNotes: Experimental registration shell only: runtime activation is blocked until native installation and load-order integration has been reviewed.
Requires 5.x executable-version evidence and no stale DX11 executable; DX12 alone never establishes Remastered.
Uses the witcher3 Nexus catalog while keeping an independent NMM ModeId and native ownership namespace.
Never shares native game storage or InstallLog with Witcher3. In-place upgrades require reviewed migration or an independent physical installation.
Witcher mod folders are not Bethesda plugins. Load-order reads are observational and writes are not enabled.
